# boredprinter

> boredprinter (https://boredprinter.com) publishes honest, practical guides on making money with a home 3D printer, by the creator behind @boredprinter on Instagram (15k followers). Free guides cover what sells, licenses, Etsy's 2025+ rules for 3D prints and pricing, plus a free price calculator. Premium online guides go deeper.

## Free guides
- [How to make money with a 3D printer](https://boredprinter.com/guides/how-to-make-money-with-a-3d-printer): The seven ways people actually make money with a home 3D printer, what each is worth, and how to pick the one that fits you.
- [Can you sell 3D prints? Licenses explained](https://boredprinter.com/guides/can-you-sell-3d-prints): What you're allowed to sell, what you're not, and how to check any model in 30 seconds.
- [How to price 3D prints](https://boredprinter.com/guides/how-to-price-3d-prints): The formula, the costs people forget, and why you're probably charging too little.
- [Selling 3D prints on Etsy in 2026](https://boredprinter.com/guides/selling-3d-prints-on-etsy): What changed in 2025, what you can still sell, what Etsy charges, and how to stay on the right side of the rules.
- [The best 3D prints to sell](https://boredprinter.com/guides/best-3d-prints-to-sell): Product types that sell, the pattern behind them, and how to find your own winner.
- [3D print price calculator](https://boredprinter.com/tools/3d-print-price-calculator): free tool to price a 3D print including filament, electricity, machine wear, labour, packaging and fees.

## Premium guides
- [Print to Profit](https://boredprinter.com/guides/print-to-profit): The complete guide to selling your 3D prints, from your first idea to your first 10 sales and beyond. ($29, online guide)
- [Design Your Own Bestseller](https://boredprinter.com/guides/design-your-own-bestseller): Go from "I only download models" to selling products that are 100% yours. ($19, online guide)
